title: Unable to reset password
description: The customer is not receiving the password reset email after requesting it multiple times.

title: Payment failed during checkout
description: The customer tried to complete a payment but the transaction failed at checkout.

title: Account verification issue
description: The customer cannot complete the account verification process because the verification code is not working.

title: Unable to update profile
description: The customer gets an error message when trying to update their profile information.

title: Order delivery is delayed
description: The customer's order has not arrived even though the estimated delivery date has passed.

title: Wrong item received
description: The customer received a different product from the one they ordered.

title: Refund has not arrived
description: The customer was informed that their refund was processed but the amount has not appeared in their account.

title: App is running slowly
description: The customer reports that the application takes a long time to load different pages.

title: Cannot download invoice
description: The customer cannot download the invoice for their recent purchase.

title: Subscription not activated
description: The customer completed the subscription payment but their premium features are still unavailable.

title: Notification emails not received
description: The customer is not receiving important notification emails from the support system.

title: Unable to contact support
description: The customer reported that the support contact form is not submitting successfully.

title: Order cancellation request
description: The customer wants to cancel their order before it is shipped.

title: Account locked after login attempts
description: The customer's account has been temporarily locked after several unsuccessful login attempts.

title: Unable to change email address
description: The customer cannot update the email address associated with their account.
